name: Toronto
line: A growing network of aesthetic nurses across the GTA, under one mark.
about: Toronto Beauty is a growing network of aesthetic nurses offering cosmetic treatments across the Greater Toronto Area.
Its world holds medical trust and luxury beauty in one mark, and gives every nurse in the network a presence of their own.
impact: Reels passed 100K views in aggregate. The site now recruits practitioners as well as clients.
alt: A marble face in profile with a single drop of serum falling from a pipette

built.Lore: The logo and identity, positioning and network standards, and real and AI-generated nurse portraits held to one look.
built.Law: Posts and ads reviewed against nursing and Health Canada rules, plus treatment pricing and promotions.
built.Language: Social media, educational content, AI-generated podcasts, Reels, ads and nurses' own profiles. Reels passed 100K views in aggregate.
built.Map: A WordPress site with a profile for every nurse and a map search, plus SEO, Google Business Profiles and online booking.
built.Artifacts: A services brochure for the network.
